comments.value:
Many times reported, thanks to poor Network IK. I always use handwriting or pens due my bad hearing, but you made VRChat very unfriendly for deaf, mute and bad hearing people... 
This is not good and must fixed ASAP.

This may be caused by the general delay with network IK. The times a player activates their gesture/marker is not delayed like IK is, so on other clients they draw at the wrong times and the result is garbled. I seem to be able to draw by holding my marker in place for a few seconds, then drawing one continuous line and holding it in place at the end for a few more seconds.
Should now be much more accurate, will get increasingly better over updates

details: It seems that the sync rate for particle based pens has dropped to unusable levels with the latest update. Some examples in this Twitter thread: https://twitter.com/bironist/status/1129065299431440384?s=19
title: Particle based pens unusable on latest update
